player_character_data.name: Cain
features: Sovereign Logic: Spend 5 Sorcery Points to force any d20 roll to be a Natural 20.
Infinite Mana Well: Spell slots of level 1-5 are never consumed.
Gestalt Mastery: Proficiency in all saving throws and all skills.
Apostle's Blessing (Max Level): Immunity to Charmed, Frightened, and Exhaustion.
Reality Warp: You may cast any spell with a casting time of 1 action as a bonus action instead.
Divine Portfolio: Space-Time Logic (Manipulate space-time laws locally in a 120ft aura, once per day)

neck.stats: Advantage on all INT/WIS/CHA checks. True Sight 120ft.
neck.name: Amulet of the Sovereign

armor.description: Sovereign Invulnerability: Immunity to non-magical physical damage. Resistance to all magical damage. Immune to forced movement.
properties: Adamantine Soul: Immune to critical hits
Divine Presence: Hostiles must succeed on a DC 26 WIS save to even target you with an attack
Eternal Fortress: Immune to all conditions (Poisoned, Stunned, etc.)
armor.name: +5 Grandmaster's Divine Plate

off_hand.description: Absolute Guard: Use reaction once per turn to negate any damage/spell. Reflects blocked spells back at source.
properties: Magic Negation: Immune to all spells of 6th level or lower
Kinetic Rebound: Reflects 100% of blocked physical damage back at the attacker
Omni-Shield: Provides 360-degree protection regardless of facing
off_hand.name: +5 Aegis of the Seven Pillars (Absolute Guard)

main_hand.name: +5 Vorpal Longsword of the Apostle (Severance of Fate)
properties: Space-Time Edge: Hits targets up to 60ft away by cutting through space
Divine Erasure: Damage dealt cannot be healed by anything less than a Wish spell
Fate Severance: Critical hits instantly destroy the target's essence/physical form
main_hand.description: Severance of Fate: Critical hits instantly decapitate or destroy essence. Ignores all damage resistances and immunities.

cloak.stats: +5 to all saving throws. Bonus Action: Misty Step at will.
